assessment: CA6 reduces nominal tracking error by 82% due to rapid zero-lag tracking.
CA6 model captures dynamic 200 px/s^2 acceleration with 92.7% error reduction.
Both CA6 variants outperform CV4 by ~50% in lead-angle extrapolation up to 100ms.
K03 is vastly superior on CA6 (17.5 vs 72.1 px). However, on non-accelerated/turning trajectories, CA6 extrapolates a^2 causing crossover above 350ms.
Zero false lock is maintained by all three estimators across S12, S13, S14, S15 and T04.
Adaptive R allows CA6 to retain continuous tracking on abrupt maneuvers (T10: 0 coast vs 13-14). T07 distractor traversal is transient in all models.
CV4 diverges heavily under dynamic motion. CA6 maintains statistical optimality (NIS ~ 1.0).
All three estimators run in <0.11 ms, consuming <6% of the 2.0 ms real-time frame budget.
